verdict.rationale: PostHog docs explicitly describe building dashboards, sharing them, and setting alerts 'on the numbers that matter' with the ability to 'get alerted when they move' (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), directly matching the story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of alert accuracy or anomaly-detection sophistication, and no detail on subscription delivery channels (email/Slack) beyond the general claim.
